remarks: No tracked port is suspended, recovering or under weather watch. None carried an entry last run either, so nothing expired.

TD 2632 from last run is now Tropical Storm Surigae (TS, 40 kt). JMA has it reaching typhoon strength near Okinawa in about 4 days. The closest forecast point to any tracked port is 846 km from Shanghai/Ningbo at +117h, outside the 600 km radius.
Watch Surigae on the next runs. Some model runs point toward Taiwan. A westward shift would bring Xiamen, Shenzhen (Yantian) and Shanghai/Ningbo into range right before Golden Week (1-7 Oct).
Busan terminals stop for Chuseok on 25 Sep. That is a holiday, not weather, so Busan is not listed as a port entry.
Search results about Super Typhoon Ragasa shutting Hong Kong and Shenzhen ports are from September 2025, not this year. They were ignored.
